prompt: What was/were the dominant polity in the Muslim world in 1000 CE?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 directly answers the prompt by naming major polities in the Muslim world around 1000 CE (Abbasid Caliphate, Fatimids, Ghaznavids, Umayyads of Córdoba), which is the closest match to “dominant polity/polities.” Candidate 2 largely shifts to economic/trade factors and systems and only tangentially mentions caliphates, failing to identify the dominant polity as asked. Candidate 3 focuses on religious movements and their interactions with politics rather than listing the dominant political powers. Candidate 4 reframes the question into a broad comparison with Europe and Asia, providing insufficient direct identification of the dominant polities in the Muslim world at 1000 CE.
